errors.evidence: The description states the value is a "prozentualen Veränderungswert" (percentage change value), but the chart itself does not specify any units, such as a percentage sign (%). This is an assumption about the data, not a direct description of the visual information.

errors.text_span: Die Länder sind innerhalb der beiden Gruppen nicht nach Größe sortiert
errors.evidence: The description claims that the countries within the two groups are not sorted by size. This is incorrect. The top group (losers) is sorted by value from most negative to least negative (-16.3 to -9.4), and the bottom group (winners) is sorted by value from smallest positive to largest positive (23.3 to 67.7).
